normalization_plan.reason: The _quantity parameter only carries user input into the mint function's arithmetic and loop.
The _paymentMethodId parameter only selects the payment branch inside mint.
_totalPrice is a computed local used solely within the mint payment logic.
The mint loop counter exists only to drive repeated _mintOne calls.
The _quantity parameter only feeds privateMint limits and mint loop.
The _claimableToken parameter only branches the claim logic.
The _tokenId parameter is only used to look up and flag the friendship NFT inside claim.
The _tokenId parameter only selects the token whose bio is updated.
The _bio parameter only supplies the new bio string written by changeBio.
The tokenId parameter only selects the token renamed by changeName.
The newName parameter only supplies the validated and reserved new name in changeName.
The _owner parameter is only the recipient passed to the ERC721 _mint call in _mintOne.
newItemId is a temporary local holding the counter value used for a single mint.
The _claimableId parameter only indexes the Claimables array in the view function.
The _tokenId parameter only indexes the claimed mapping in the view function.
The owner parameter is only forwarded to transferOwnership during initialization.
The _adminImplementation parameter is stored and later consumed by the delegatecall in delegateToAdmin.
